items.text: kab aayega
order kahan hai
late ho raha hai
thoda intazaar karna padega
carrier kaha hai
exact delivery time
apka address kya hai
shipment status
tracking number do
kya dispatch hua hai
parcel mil gaya kya
kab mil jayega

items.context: Kab aapke order ki delivery hogi?
items.text: kal tak pahunch jayega

items.context: Aapka parcel kab dispatch hua tha?
items.text: order abhi dispatch hua

items.context: Kya aapne delivery boy se sampark kiya?
items.text: delivery boy se baat kar raha hu
mera order tracking 1234 5678 9012 status batayiye
please bataiye ki mera parcel delhi se kab niklega
order last week 10 april ko diya tha dost ke liye
kya aap confirm kar sakte hain mera shipment dispatch ho gaya hai
mai ek baar fir se apni delivery date confirm karna chahta hu
mera phone number 98765 43210 hai jiske naam par order hai
kya mera parcel aaj raat tak Mumbai pahunch jayega

items.context: Kya aapne tracking number ke saath online check kiya hai?
items.text: haan sahi bola aaj raat tak aayega

items.context: Kya parcel aapke address par deliver ho gaya?
items.text: nahi mujhe parcel ke baare mein zyada information nahi mili

items.context: Aapka delivery address kya hai please?
items.text: mera pincode 560076 hai aur delivery pending aa raha hai

items.context: Kya aapne parcel abhi tak receive kiya hai?
items.text: mera parcel last status show karta hai out for delivery

items.context: Aapke order number se mujhe tracking karna hoga
items.text: mem dd7865 package hai aur delay ka reason janna hai
maine 12 april ko online order kiya tha aur mujhe abhi tak mera parcel receive nahi hua hai
mera address change ho gaya hai to main aapko naya address batana chahta hu jahan mera parcel deliver karwana hai
order confirmation ke baad mujhe ek sms aaya tha jisme delivery date 15 april mention thi but mujhe parcel nahi mila ab tak

items.context: Aapne apna order kab place kiya tha?
items.text: order ki delivery me 3 din ka delay ho gaya hai kya aap batayenge ki parcel ab kahaan hai

items.context: Kya aapke paas tracking ID hai jisse main check kar saku?
items.text: 23 april ko mera parcel dispatch hua tha lekin mujhe koi update nahi mila abhi tak uspe kya progress hai

items.context: Apna naam aur order number batayiye
items.text: mera naam Rahul Sharma hai aur mera order number 4567 8910 1112 hai mujhe order status batayein jald se jald please

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: where_is_order - asks where their order or parcel is
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
